subject: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightline Advisors <consultant@brightlinehr.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling

Folks —

Putting together a lean set of templates and an escalation grid for the 2027 review cycle. Goal: make manager outreach + calibration faster while protecting sensitive-role workflows (ICs in security, infra, and legal-adjacent roles). Draft attached: comm_templates_v2.md and a proposed escalation grid embedded below.

High-level asks:
- Laura / Marissa: confirm legal/HR wording for the confidentiality clause and redaction guidance.
- Vivek: flag teams with quiet-list requirements; we should lock their communications to manager-only until calibration completes.
- Priyom: can you confirm dates in the cadence (manager self-assess opens, peer feedback window, calibration week)? I've suggested the timeline in-line.

Proposed timeline (quick):
- Mar 14: Manager self-assess template published (Drive link + email)
- Mar 21 - Apr 4: Peer feedback window (opt-in)
- Apr 11 - Apr 15: Manager calibrations (leadership only access to drafts)
- Apr 18: Final ratings locked; comms to employees begin Apr 19 (staggered, sensitive first)

Escalation grid (very condensed):
- Day 0-3 after sensitive comms: manager -> People Ops (Marissa) -> HR Legal (Laura) -> Exec sponsor (Karthik)
- Compensation appeals: manager -> compensation council -> VP review -> CPO sign-off

Attachments: manager_self_assessment_template.docx, calibration_rubric.xlsx, comm_templates_v2.md, redaction_instructions.pdf (stubs attached).

Thanks — sharing early for comments.

— Karthik
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few HR edits inline and one policy ask: any template that requests peer feedback must include the optional anonymization checkbox and an opt-out instruction. I've attached redaction_instructions.pdf with the wording we should include in the manager note.

Specific suggestions:
- Add an explicit statement in all comms: "If you believe your role requires quiet handling for security/regulatory reasons, speak to your manager ASAP."
- For the calibration week, preserve a "manager-only" view and only surface role-level rationales (no raw peer comments) unless someone signs off with a documented justification.
- For the escalation grid, add an additional step: if legal review is required, notify the Exec sponsor and pause outbound comms until review concludes.

I'm okay with the proposed timeline but recommend shifting the peer window earlier by two days to allow more time for managers to synthesize.

Attaching: redaction_instructions.pdf

Laura Bennett
VP, People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling

Quick notes from Eng leadership perspective:
- Quiet-list teams: Platform Security, Core Inference, Compliance Integrations. For those groups, please ensure comms are manager-to-employee only (no automated all-hands or team slack messages) until calibration closes.
- Compensation alignment: some ICs on infra-path ladders expect mid-cycle adjustments; we should carve a separate appeals path that doesn't block broader comms.
- Manager bandwidth: the proposed calibration week is tight for some teams; recommend we open a second calibration slot the following week for teams with >15 reports.

Also: please include a short manager script for sensitive comms (two-sentence template) so managers don't over-share. I drafted one in the Drive doc.

Vivek
VP Engineering

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling

All —

Thanks for the feedback. Updated timeline proposal below (to accommodate earlier peer window and extra calibration buffer):
- Mar 12: Manager self-assess template published (move up 2 days)
- Mar 16 - Mar 30: Peer feedback window (opt-in, anonymization available)
- Apr 6 - Apr 15: Manager calibrations (two slots; primary Apr 6-9, overflow Apr 13-15)
- Apr 18: Final ratings locked (still target)
- Apr 19 - Apr 23: Staggered outbound comms; sensitive roles begin Apr 19 morning

I've attached calibration_rubric.xlsx (stub) with suggested scoring buckets and a compact justification prompt to aid calibration. Also added a checklist for managers to confirm redaction rules before sending.

Priyom
Director, People Operations Programs

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual review: comms templates, escalation grid, and sensitive-role handling

Great feedback — thanks everyone. Action items I will own and next steps: 
- Karthik: stitch the templates and redaction language into a single manager packet and post to Drive by EOD Friday (Drive link above).
- Laura / Marissa: confirm legal wording and anonymization checkbox by Monday EOD; Laura to confirm whether we need a separate consent flow for anonymized peer feedback.
- Vivek: provide final quiet-list team roster by Mon 9AM so we can lock communication channels appropriately.
- Priyom: publish the updated timeline and enable the calibration overflow slots in the scheduling tool.

I will follow up with a consolidated comm that includes the manager script and DocuSign instructions for signatures where needed (comp council forms). Expect the consolidated packet by Friday.

Attachments (stubs): manager_self_assessment_template.docx, calibration_rubric.xlsx, comm_templates_v2.md, redaction_instructions.pdf

Thanks — I'll loop Brightline if we need external review.

— Karthik
Head of Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
